| **title-zomb-idle-seconds** | Title zombie: the idle loop is a DURATION in seconds, not a step count | cline | code | 3 | S | The idle state asked for 60 STEPS. A step is not a unit of time: at the GameMaker 8 30 fps 60 steps was 2 s, at 60 fps it is 1 s, so the loop plays twice as fast as it did in the original build (LL-072: the vertical half of LL-030, which fixed the same mistake for the tower loops by asking for a period in steps). Fix: scr_animSpeedForSeconds(sprite, seconds, tag) in scr_animSpeedForSteps.gml converts seconds to steps at the CURRENT frame rate and hands them to scr_animSpeedForSteps, so no maths is duplicated and a frame-rate change cannot resurrect the bug; ANIM_SECONDS_ZOMBIE_IDLE 2.0 is the one number to retune. obj_titleZomb case 0 calls it; walk and grab keep their 60 steps on purpose, they are meant to read faster. One ANIM line per tag per run, guarded so it cannot throw (LL-002). Honest caveat: the recovered GM8 source says image_speed 0.5, which for this 16-frame art at 30 fps is 32 steps = 1.07 s, not 2 s - so if 2.0 reads sluggish, the number to change is the macro, not the mechanism. Falsifier: an ANIM line that says steps=60, or 60 steps still hard-coded at the idle call site. |
| **ui-icon-origins** | UI art: place a picture by its ART rect, not its origin | cline | code | 3 | M | Three defects, one fix. (1) icon_draw subtracted the origin that draw_sprite_ext had already honoured, so every centred-origin icon drew half an icon up and left - spr_offense (48 canvas, 44x41 art, origin 24,24) painted at x 1.3..30.7 when the caller asked to centre it on x 32. The docblock defending the subtraction had been generalised from the two blood-tree icons whose origin is (0,0), which are the only sprites it was right for. (2) meta_sprite_fit scaled the 192x192 CANVAS: a thumbnail came out at 46-75% of its cell, a different size per tower, sitting low because the art centre is 25-40px below the canvas centre - and Cannon Tulip and Meat Bulb poked out of the top of the shop cell. (3) it registered the CANVAS rect as kind image while rules.py had no image rule at all (images and anything else: not a rule yet), and the branch icon registered a hand-typed 16..50 box while its art was painted at 1..31 - so the gate was judging rectangles nobody had drawn, and said every screen was clean. Fix: new scr_ui_image places the ART rect. ui_art_bbox (sprite_get_bbox_*, +1 because the far edge is inclusive; a no-art sprite falls back to its canvas; nothing throws), ui_art_scale (min fit, capped at 1 - the clamp meta_sprite_fit had documented and never enforced), ui_art_rect, ui_art_draw (the origin is read ONCE, to convert canvas coords into a draw position, and the rect it painted is what gets registered) and ui_art_fit (one overflow line that reads only its own arguments). icon_draw and meta_sprite_fit kept their signatures and became thin callers, so all five call sites were untouched. rules.py gained a fifth rule: an image inside its cell is fine, an image big enough to be a backdrop behind a label is fine, art over text / art crossing its cell edge / two pictures on the same pixels are findings. Checked against the sprite .yy files rather than by eye: all 12 tower sheets land y 100..176 (one height, inside the cell - Pina 519..579, Daisy 516..582, Cannon Tulip 510..588), and every icon centres +0.0,+0.0 on the point passed, including the (0,0)-origin spr_blood_magnet and spr_blood_moon. So normalising those two origins is no longer needed anywhere and the .yy files were left alone. roundtrip 768 files 0 differ; 247 tests OK (+3: four new image tests replacing the not-a-rule-yet one). |
| **ui-meta-button-w** | UI: a meta button is as wide as its label, and its band column as wide as the buttons | cline | code | 3 | S | Root cause: the World Map exits were 100-wide nodes holding a 107-wide label at 16pt, inside a band column that was a fixed 240 - two fixed numbers trying to describe a width that belongs to the FONT. Garden Book was therefore painted 7 units past its own button and 7 past its column, into the title, at every canvas size. Fix in scr_ui_layout_meta: ui_meta_btn_w(labels) returns the widest label at 16pt plus UI_META_BTN_PAD 24 - the same string_width+24 scr_scaleButton gives a menu button - floored at 64. It is ONE width per row, so every button in a row is the same size: the World Map row is 131 for both buttons because Garden Book is its widest label, Deploy and Back are 81 each, Return is 85, Retry, Next and World Map are 113 each. A font that is not loaded yet makes ui_text_width return -1, which is not a width (LL-002), so the row falls back to UI_META_BTN_MIN and logs it. ui_meta_band now derives the action column from the sum of its children plus gaps, floors it at UI_META_ACTS 240 so Deploy still has its right-hand Loadout column, caps it at half the band and logs when it caps, and gives head.info the same width so the title stays centred between two equal columns. meta_button_draw fits its label with ui_fit_font(text, box minus 12, [16,12]) as the second line of defence: a rect that arrives from anywhere else shrinks rather than spills. Falsifier: any spill with a button_label in it, or head.acts narrower than the buttons it holds. |
| **ui-meta-currency-foot** | UI: the Seeds, Clover, Towers and Badges counters move to a centred strip at the bottom | cline | code | 3 | S | Root cause: the four counters were painted into a 240-wide band column while measuring ~373 at 12pt and ~482 at 16pt, so they were drawn straight over the page title on EVERY meta screen - the top band never had a column that could hold them, and at 675 wide it has none at all. Fix: the line has its own ROW (ui_meta_cur_strip), appended by ui_meta_tree so all four screens get it, full width and the LAST child of the root, so its box is h minus margin minus one line to h minus margin and nothing can be placed under it. Its height is MEASURED - the 16pt text line or the 20-unit currency icons, whichever is taller (ui_meta_cur_h) - so the centre is margin + cur_h/2 = 26 units above the canvas bottom, a relationship that survives a font or margin change instead of a number that goes stale. meta_currency_draw centres the INK - the trailing 20 units meta_currency_width counts are slack, not ink, so they come off first or the line sits 10 units left of centre - and meta_currency_size is now the ONE chooser of 16pt vs 12pt, used by both the centring and the paint, so the two cannot disagree. ui_meta_body_h gives Deploy and the Garden Book their body height with the strip already deducted; their hand-copied sums would otherwise have put the wall row's cells under the footer. head.cal is renamed head.info and now holds only Deploy's Region/Stage line. Results gets the line too, which it never showed before. Falsifier: a cur rect that leaves the canvas or touches the footer at 675, a meta_currency_line call left in the band, or a spill between a cur text and the page title. |
